spoken_summary: The audio consists solely of sung lyrics from the song "Roc Steady," synchronized with the on-screen text. The lines include "rock, rock steady" and "you can tell who I am from the back cuz it's heavy."
audio_music: The video is set to the hip-hop track "Roc Steady (feat. Flo Milli)" by Megan Thee Stallion and Flo Milli. The song plays throughout, and its lyrics are used to create a mocking effect.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single static image with text overlays that change once.
central_claim: The post mocks Donald Trump's physical appearance by pairing a photo of him from behind with song lyrics about having a "heavy" backside.
intended_effect: To ridicule Donald Trump and make viewers laugh at his expense.
